speaker: mira
text: Look, Sol! This old lantern still flickers. Should we fix it in the workshop, or take it to the rooftop and watch the sky?

speaker: sol
text: The loose switch is fixed! We can share the warm light with our neighbors, or carry it upstairs for a quiet night of stars.

speaker: mira
text: The city looks different from up here. We could stay and count the stars, or bring this little light back to our neighbors.

speaker: sol
text: One little lantern gave us something to share. Tomorrow, let us invite everyone to make a lantern of their own. The end.

speaker: mira
text: We found no secret treasure, but we found time to wonder together. Tomorrow, we will draw the constellations we imagined. The end.
